intro: Snore No Drops is an ayurvedic blend designed to open nasal passages and support calm, quiet sleep. Taken regularly before bedtime, it helps ease nighttime congestion and snoring, encouraging deeper rest and refreshed mornings. Best results occur alongside lifestyle steps like side‑sleeping, weight management, and avoiding late heavy meals; outcomes vary by individual. This is a supportive wellness product, not a medical treatment.
